nodes.name: The Weep
nodes.description: Free-roam activities, bounties, public events.

nodes.name: Lake of Shadows
nodes.description: Purge the European Dead Zone of the Taken and Shadow Legion forces threatening to overtake the Reservoir and poison the precious water it holds.

nodes.name: Devrim Kay
nodes.subtitle: Dead Zone Sniper
nodes.description: Ever the gentleman sniper, Devrim Kay holds fast in the wilds of the EDZ.

nodes.name: Trostland
nodes.description: Travel to Trostland

nodes.name: Warlord's Ruin
nodes.description: Nestled deep in the mountains of the EDZ, Scorn lay claim to a Dark Age castle containing dangerous relics, and a blighted vengeance festers in the dirt.

nodes.name: The Sludge
nodes.description: Travel to the Sludge.

nodes.name: Winding Cove
nodes.description: Travel to Winding Cove.

nodes.name: The Arms Dealer
nodes.description: Stifle the legacy of a notorious ironmonger providing weapons to the Shadow Legion.

nodes.name: Shard of the Traveler
nodes.description: Gain your new Powers, Guardian.

nodes.name: Shaw Han
nodes.description: A skilled Hunter, Shaw leads fireteams on dangerous missions throughout the solar system.

nodes.name: The Steppes
nodes.description:
Scour the Old Russian stronghold on Earth to protect the City's interests.

Travel to the Steppes.

nodes.name: Grasp of Avarice
nodes.description: A cautionary tale for adventurers willing to trade their humanity for riches.

nodes.name: Skywatch
nodes.description: Travel to the Skywatch.

nodes.name: The Devils' Lair
nodes.description:
The Fallen House of Devils in the Cosmodrome sustains its strength through a single Servitor Known as Sepiks Prime. Find where this keeper of souls lies and destroy him.

Enter into the Devil's Lair and weaken the Fallen presence within the Cosmodrome.

nodes.name: The Disgraced
nodes.description: Defeat the shamed Hive Wizard Navôta in the Cosmodrome.

nodes.name: Fallen S.A.B.E.R.
nodes.description:
Rush to the Aid of the AI Warmind Rasputin as he broadcasts a plea for help across the system.

Enter Rasputin's bunker in the Cosmodrome and discover the source of the security breach.

nodes.name: Fist of Crota
nodes.description: Face the Fist of Crota leading the Spawn on Earth.

nodes.name: The Warmind
nodes.description: Break the House of Devil's grasp on the Cosmodrome and secure a vital link to the Golden Age.

nodes.name: A Symbol of Honor
nodes.description: Explore the past for hints to forge a new Gjallarhorn.

nodes.name: The Will of Crota
nodes.description: Omnigul, the mastermind of Crota's armies, nests in the Cosmodrome. Eliminate this horror and purge its spawn.

nodes.name: Beauty in Delivery
nodes.description: Assault a Fallen stronghold. Forge your Gjallarhorn.

nodes.name: The Last Array
nodes.description: Track down codes to raise an ancient Array and connect it to long-lost colonies throughout the solar system.

nodes.name: The Dark Within
nodes.description: Investigate reports of a hidden power trapped in the Cosmodrome Array stations.

nodes.name: Cayde's Stash
nodes.description: Ascend a colony ship in the Cosmodrome in search of Cayde's lost cache.

nodes.name: The Silent Fang
nodes.description: Stop Skolas's elite assassins before they tear through the Cosmodrome.

nodes.name: Restoration
nodes.description: Return to Fallen territory and hunt for parts to restore your ship's ability for interplanetary travel.

nodes.name: Blighted Coven
nodes.description: Investigate the rumors of a Taken coven in the Cosmodrome.

nodes.name: Kings of Decay
nodes.description: Hunt the source of the Taken blight across the Cosmodrome.

nodes.name: The Promethean Code
nodes.description: Slip past Rasputin's defenses and download stealth code protocols from his Golden Age database.

nodes.name: Siege of the Warmind
nodes.description: Find Rasputin's bunker. Defend it against the Hive attack.

nodes.name: The First Firewall
nodes.description: Investigate Vault RAS-2 and investigate the source of the strange signal.

nodes.name: The Ruling House
nodes.description: Scour the Cosmodrome for Skolas and the invading Wolves.

nodes.name: The Walls come down
nodes.description: The Cosmodrome has been transformed by an ancient threat. Find the source of the corruption.

nodes.name: King of the Mountain
nodes.description: Lord Saladin has called you to defend an abandoned mountaintop observatory from a Fallen assault

nodes.name: Iron Temple
nodes.description: The ancient fortress of the Iron Lords is alive with activity once more.

nodes.name: Saint-14
nodes.description: A legendary hero and the former Titan Vanguard, Saint-14 disappeared into the Infinite Forest only to be later rescued by a fellow Guardian.

nodes.name: Courtyard
nodes.description: Travel to the Courtyard.

nodes.name: Commander Zavala
nodes.description: The resolute Commander Zavala advises Guardians on all Vanguard-related activities.

nodes.name: Ironwood Tree
nodes.description: Monument to Fellowship

nodes.name: Tess Eversi
nodes.description: Tess Everis is an accomplished broker of stylish and highly coveted items procured from the City and beyond.

nodes.name: Kadi 55-30
nodes.description: Postmaster Frames dutifully oversee deliveries, messages, and lost items.

nodes.name: Quest Archive
nodes.description: Kiosk to acquire old or abandoned quests.

nodes.name: Lord Shaxx
nodes.description: The Crucible is the arena in which Guardians forge their Light. Lord Shaxx is the Crucible.

nodes.name: Banshee-44
nodes.description: Banshee-44 has lived many lives. As master weaponsmith for the Tower, he supplies Guardians with only the best.

nodes.name: Master Rahool
nodes.description: A senior representative of the Cryptarchy, Master Rahool decodes engrams and seeks the treasures of humanity's past.

nodes.name: Monument to Seasons Past
nodes.description: The Seasonal Archive offers rewards from prior Season and Rewards Passes. Acquire rewards with Chronologs, which are earned from the Rewards Pass or through purchase of an Archived Pass.

nodes.name: Monument to Lost Lights
nodes.description: Built to honor of those who sacrificed their Light to defend humanity. Created in collaboration with Cryptarchs to help Guardians manage armaments.

nodes.name: Special Deliveries
nodes.description: Receive special gifts and rewards from various sources.

nodes.name: Xûr
nodes.description: A peddler of strange curios, Xûr's motives are not his own. He bows to his distant masters, the Nine.

nodes.name: Suraya Hawthrone
nodes.description: Once a wanderer beyond the City, Suraya Hawthrone now acts as a liaison between humanity and the Guardians.

nodes.name: Ikora Rey
nodes.description: The wise Ikora Rey aids and advises Guardians in the protection of humanity and beyond.

nodes.name: The Drifter
nodes.description: The name says it all.

nodes.name: Ada-1
nodes.description: Advanced Prototype Exo and warden of the Black Armory.

nodes.name: Loom
nodes.description: A matter programming engine, designed by Ada-1 using Golden Age schematics. Used to create Synthweave for Armor Synthesis.

nodes.name: Annex
nodes.description: Travel to the Annex.

nodes.name: Hope
nodes.description: Commander Zavala is building a resistance at a moon of Saturn. Make contact and join the fight

nodes.name: Riptide
nodes.description: Without power, Zavala's resistance has hit a wall. Travel deeper into the Arcology and help them past it.

nodes.name: Utopia
nodes.description: Venture deeep into the heart of the Hive to retrieve a powerful Golden Age CPU - and make it out alive

nodes.name: Savathûn's Song
nodes.description: Delve deep into the Hive-infested Arcology in search of missing fireteams.

nodes.name: Ishtar Collective
nodes.description: Unravel the secrets of the Vex by reviving an ancient research station of the Ishtar Collective.

nodes.name: Paradox
nodes.description: Investigate the signal coming from the Vault of Glass.

nodes.name: Vault of Glass
nodes.description: Beneath Venus, evil stirs.

nodes.name: The Archive
nodes.description: Find the Collective's lost Archive, sealed for centuries, in a vault deep beneath the Ishtar Academy.

nodes.name: A Stranger's Call
nodes.description: Follow the Stranger's coordinates to a legendary colony lost in the jungle of Venus.

nodes.name: Headlands
nodes.description: Keep watch in the Ishtar Sink to aid the City in its efforts.

nodes.name: The Nexus
nodes.description: The Golden Age legends tell of ancient tunnels below the Academy, where a Vex machine once ate away at the planet. Descend into the old dig sites and find this Nexus before it churns again.

nodes.name: Eye of a Gate Lord
nodes.description: Lure out the Vex Gate Lord that protects the Endless Steps and bring its head back io the Awoken.

nodes.name: Wolves' Gambit
nodes.description: Track Skolas and his crew of Wolves along the Ishtar Cliffs.

nodes.name: Echo Chamber
nodes.description: Guardians destroyed the Nexus on Venus. Now, a powerful Vex mind seeks to sunder time and space and undo what was done.

nodes.name: Queen's Ransom
nodes.description: Follow Skolas into Vex territory to aid in his capture for the Queen.

nodes.name: A Kell Rising
nodes.description: Head off the House of Wolves on Venus before their Kell, Skolas, can wrest control of the House of Winter.

nodes.name: Scourge of Winter
nodes.description: Hunt and kill Draksis, the House of Winter's Kell, hiding deep in the caves of the Ishtar Sink.

nodes.name: Entropy's Pinnacle
nodes.description: Scale the Vex Citadel and hunt down the source of Venus's blight.

nodes.name: Winter's Run
nodes.description: As the Vex march to claim the Ishtar Sink, the Fallen House of Winter is raising a powerful Archon, stolen from the Prison of Elders in the Reef. Find the Archon before they fully restore his soul.

nodes.name: Vow of the Disciple
nodes.description: The disciple beckons...

nodes.name: Sundered Doctrine
nodes.description: Power lies in the deepest vault.

nodes.name: Birthplace of the Vile
nodes.description: Aided by the Witness, the Scorn have gained the power to break into the Throne World through areas the Light cannot touch.

nodes.name: Catalyst
nodes.description: Witness the memory linked to the Enigma. The entry point is located deep within the Temple of the Wrathful.

nodes.name: The Lightblade
nodes.description: Recover an artifact from a monument to Oryx, located deep in the swamps of Savathûn's throne world.

nodes.name: Insight
nodes.description: Revisit the memory linked to the Tablet of Ruin. The entry is located deep within the Sepulcher Lost Sector.

nodes.name: Fynch
nodes.description: A Hive Ghost who no longer believes the Hive deserve the Light, Fynch has defected from Savathûn's followers in order to help humanity.

nodes.name: Quagmire
nodes.description: Travel to the Quagmire.

nodes.name: Spire of the Watcher
nodes.description: Machinations run wild in this dust-ridden ruin. Bring them to heel.

nodes.name: The Enclave
nodes.description: The Hidden's base of operations on Mars.

nodes.name: Preservation
nodes.description: Enter the Throne World Pyramid and prevent the Scorn from reclaiming its power.

nodes.name: Normal
nodes.description: This is the Normal Destiny campaign, enjoyed alone or with a fireteam.

nodes.name: Legendary
nodes.description:
Rise to a higher level of challenge.

You will face harder missions and stronger combatants. Recommended for experienced players with a broad arsenal to draw upon.

nodes.name: Weekly Mission
nodes.description: Track Savathûn on Mars, where temporal abnormalities scar the planet's surface and the Cabal seek to claim new territory.

nodes.name: The Buried City
nodes.description: Clear out the Cabal occupying the lost city of Freehold and explore what remains.

nodes.name: Dust Palace
nodes.description: A new Cabal force has unleashed powerful Psion Flayers to seize control of the old Martian Warmind. Face this new threat and secure what remains of the ancient network.

nodes.name: Download Complete
nodes.description: Open the forgotten archives at Clovis Bray, and search for a way to defend against SIVA.

nodes.name: Fear's Embrace
nodes.description: Return to the base on Phobos. Destroy the blighted source on Mars.

nodes.name: The Coming War
nodes.description: Travel to Phobos and investigate the Cabal distress signal.

nodes.name: The Barrens
nodes.description: Fight through the shifting Martian dunes to protect the City's interests.

nodes.name: A Rising Tide
nodes.description: Find and destroy the source of the Vex surging to protect the Black Garden.

nodes.name: Tenebrous Tunnels
nodes.description: Seek out the source of the Taken blight on Mars.

nodes.name: A New Den
nodes.description: Track the House of Wolves across the surface of Mars.

nodes.name: The Prime's Path
nodes.description: Hunt the Prime Servitor that has brought together the broken House of Wolves.

nodes.name: Exclusion Zone
nodes.description: Survive the military power of the Cabal and find the Gate to the Black Garden.

nodes.name: The Undying Mind
nodes.description: An ancient Mind, feared by the Vex themselves, hides among the channels of the Black Garden. Find this machine and end its existance.

nodes.name: The Black Garden
nodes.description: Fight through the Gate and enter the Black Garden to destroy its heart.

nodes.name: The Garden's Spire
nodes.description: Seize control of the Black Garden Spire held behind the wall of the Cabal Warbase and wake the Gate Lord's Eye.

nodes.name: Cerberus Vae III
nodes.description: Just beyond their warbase, Valus Ta'aurc, Fleet Commander of the Cabal Siege Dancers, hides in a Imperial Land Tank. Fight through his guard and stop this terror before he destroys all of Freehold.
